title: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan to Visit Maharashtra on September 18
body_text:
Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan will visit Mumbai, Lonavala and Pune in Maharashtra on September 18, 2026.
During his visit, he will pay darshan at Lalbaugcha Raja in Mumbai in the morning.
In the afternoon, the Vice-President will visit Lonavala to attend the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of Gordhandas Seksaria College of Yoga & Cultural Synthesis, Kaivalyadhama .
In the evening, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan will attend the 38th edition of the Pune Festival at Shri Ganesh Kala Krida Rangmanch, Nehru Stadium, Pune.
